articles.title: Antonelli Takes Madrid Win as Norris's Luck Runs Out: 'That's Racing Sometimes'
articles.summary: Kimi Antonelli won the first Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, extending his F1 lead to 81 points. But a seven-second McLaren pit stop cost Lando Norris a win he seemed certain to take.

articles.title: Plane Loses Power at Night: Wisconsin Congressman Swims From Sinking Aircraft to Safety
articles.summary: Rep. Tom Tiffany's small plane lost power and landed in Lake Wausau, Wisconsin, on Saturday night. He and pilot Leonard Boltz swam to shallow water before an airboat rescued them.

articles.title: Federal Judge Blocks FEMA's 50% Staffing Cut: 'Pulled From Thin Air'
articles.summary: A federal judge ruled that a Homeland Security plan to cut FEMA's staff by half was unlawful, saying the number 'appears as if pulled from thin air.' The cuts were never carried out.
